html:
We go through different seasons in our lifetime;
however sometimes we need to be brought back to the foundation of our soul.  
Do you feel sometimes you just can't get through an invisible glass wall to get to where you want to be?

Do you feel like you need some help in organizing your life
so you can achieve all the things you think God wants you to achieve?
​
Do you want a more intimate relationship with the Lord and know just what He wants you to do?​

Do you want more healthy, happy and loving relationships?
Below are 4 coaching avenues to explore. These are in order they are for a reason!
We as individuals always want to put the cart before the horse.
God wants our foundation solid first
​and many of us waste time or fail because our house isn't in order.
Open-Heart Coaching
We have all been wounded at some point in our life. 
As children, we just internalize these wounds.  As adults, we try to dismiss or bury them.
Not addressing these hurts alter our thinking, our relationships, our performance, and our life's path. 

Open-Heart Coaching or Emotional Healing is God's gift to us. 
It helps us find freedom from the emotional aftermath of hurtful, harmful or traumatic experiences.
​Because it is Holy Spirit given, it is like going through many counseling sessions in a very short period of time. 
This type of coaching is lead by the Holy Spirit and the Lord does the healing.
​It is truly life changing!  

Individuals that understand this process can walk a person down this miraculous path.

It's like going through emotional open heart surgery.
At times during coaching sessions, 
you may feel raw and vulnerable as you confront the painful areas of your life and do the hard work of personal growth. 
But don't let that scare you because
​what's on the other side of the healing is truly life changing! 
Relationship Coaching
Your relationships with others impact almost every aspect of your life.
The foundation of every relationship is communication​ and yet, even among those who care about or love each other,
misunderstandings can happen and feelings can get hurt.
Sometimes we can feel the other person either doesn't care about our feelings or maybe doesn't even hear us.
One of the worst feelings is to be with someone and feel utterly alone.
Ineffective communication skills can adversely affect all your relationships both personally and with your career.
​This can cause needless stress for one or both parties. It can also affect performance and your overall self-confidence.
Personal Productivity Coaching
In our fast pace world, we have had to wear many hats.  Time counts.
Learn how to be much more productive and organized in many areas of life.
This will help eliminate stress and improve the quality of life; which in turn,
​will affect your health, family and relationships.
Life Purpose Coaching
You were created to have intimacy with God....first and foremost
but also God has a job for you to do for Him.
He has uniquely gifted you for this calling.
Learn how to hear His voice, be led by Him in all that you do and fulfill what you have been put on this earth to do.
During our sessions, we will listen to your words and heart, ask questions, gently speak the truth and
share insights about possibilities and obstacles to help speed your growth and development. 
Think of us as your partner for success.

A coach does not diagnosis.  
A coach provides guidance, encouragement, creative ideas, support and accountability.

Life Coaching Sessions are offered by PHONE, ZOOM/FACETIME or IN-PERSON
Invest in Yourself
